across.es: en todo; a lo largo de

after.en: named after: given the name of

alert.en: a warning to be ready for danger
alert.ex: The city is on high alert tonight.

also.ex: She speaks French and also Spanish.

alter.ex: Small mistakes can alter the final result.

am.en: in the morning (used after a time)
am.ex: The shop opens at 9am every day.

anticipated.ex: The concert was bigger than anticipated.

example.en: We anticipate heavy traffic during the holiday.
example.zh: 我們預期假期期間交通會很擁擠。

note.meaning: 預期、預料；文中 is anticipated to 指預計暴風會從愛爾蘭南方經過。
note.usage: 及物動詞，可接名詞、動名詞或 that 子句；被動 be anticipated to do 很常見。

noteEs.exampleTr: Prevemos mucho tráfico durante las vacaciones.
noteEs.meaning: Prever o esperar algo; aquí, se prevé que la tormenta pase al sur.
noteEs.usage: Verbo transitivo; es común 'be anticipated to do' y 'anticipate problems'.

noteHi.exampleTr: हमें छुट्टियों में भारी ट्रैफ़िक की उम्मीद है।
noteHi.meaning: पहले से अनुमान लगाना, उम्मीद करना; यहाँ तूफ़ान के दक्षिण से गुज़रने का अनुमान है।
noteHi.usage: be anticipated to do, anticipate problems आम प्रयोग हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 休暇中は交通渋滞が激しいと予想している。
noteJa.meaning: 予期する、予想する。記事では嵐がアイルランドの南を通ると予想されていることを指す。
noteJa.usage: 他動詞。受動態 be anticipated to do や anticipate problems がよく使われる。

noteKo.exampleTr: 우리는 휴일 동안 교통이 혼잡할 것으로 예상한다.
noteKo.meaning: 예상하다, 예측하다. 기사에서는 폭풍이 아일랜드 남쪽을 지날 것으로 예상된다는 뜻이다.
noteKo.usage: 타동사로 수동태 be anticipated to do, anticipate problems 등으로 쓴다.

applied.en: was in effect for a place
applied.ex: The new rule applied to all students.

appointed.en: chose someone officially for a job
appointed.ex: The school appointed a new head teacher.

approached.ex: The plane approached the airport slowly.

approaches.ex: The train slows down as it approaches the station.

approaching.ex: The plane is approaching the airport now.

areas.ex: This area is popular with young families.

as.en: while; at the same time that

at.en: in or near a place or time

austen.en: name of the storm and of Austen Nagle

autumn.ex: The leaves turn red in autumn.

be.en: to exist or have a quality

bearing.en: bear down on: move closer in a threatening way
bearing.ex: A huge truck was bearing down on our small car.

became.ex: The small shop became very popular.

because.en: because of: as a result of

being.en: form of be, used in 'is being done'

big.ex: It was a big decision for the family.

bringing.ex: The new year is bringing big changes at work.

cause.ex: Ice on the road can cause accidents.

change.ex: I want to change my job next year.

changes.ex: The new manager made some changes to the plan.

check.en: look at something to make sure it is right
check.ex: Please check your answers before you finish.

closes.en: close in on: comes nearer and nearer to
closes.ex: The police closed in on the thief.

come.en: come into effect: start to apply
come.ex: The new law will come into effect in May.

coming.ex: A storm is coming from the west.

conditions.en: the weather or situation at a particular time

consequently.ex: It rained all day; consequently, the match was cancelled.

example.en: He missed the bus and consequently arrived late.
example.zh: 他錯過了公車，因此遲到了。

note.meaning: 因此、結果；文中指因為暴風逼近，氣象局因而發布黃色雨量警報。
note.usage: 副詞，表示因果，常置句首或助動詞後，比 so 正式。

noteEn.usage: A formal linking word, often at the start of a sentence or after 'has/have'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Perdió el autobús y, por consiguiente, llegó tarde.
noteEs.meaning: Por consiguiente, como resultado; aquí, el aviso se emitió por la llegada de la tormenta.
noteEs.usage: Adverbio más formal que 'so'; va al inicio de la frase o tras el auxiliar.

noteHi.exampleTr: उसकी बस छूट गई और परिणामस्वरूप वह देर से पहुँचा।
noteHi.meaning: परिणामस्वरूप, इसलिए; यहाँ तूफ़ान आने के कारण चेतावनी जारी की गई।
noteHi.usage: क्रियाविशेषण, so से अधिक औपचारिक; वाक्य की शुरुआत या सहायक क्रिया के बाद।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼はバスに乗り遅れ、その結果遅刻した。
noteJa.meaning: その結果、したがって。記事では嵐が近づいたため警報が出されたことを表す。
noteJa.usage: 副詞で so より硬い。文頭や助動詞の後に置く。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그는 버스를 놓쳐서 결국 늦게 도착했다.
noteKo.meaning: 그 결과, 따라서. 기사에서는 폭풍이 다가와서 경보가 발령되었다는 뜻이다.
noteKo.usage: 부사로 so보다 격식 있다. 문장 앞이나 조동사 뒤에 둔다.

contingent.ex: The trip is contingent on good weather.

example.en: The trip is contingent on good weather.
example.zh: 這趟旅行要看天氣好不好而定。

note.meaning: 視…而定、取決於；文中指最惡劣天氣的分布取決於暴風的確切路徑。
note.usage: 形容詞，固定搭配 be contingent on/upon sth；也可作名詞「代表團」。

noteEs.exampleTr: El viaje depende de que haga buen tiempo.
noteEs.meaning: Que depende de algo; aquí, el reparto del mal tiempo depende de la trayectoria.
noteEs.usage: Se usa 'be contingent on/upon sth'. Como sustantivo: 'contingente'.

noteHi.exampleTr: यात्रा अच्छे मौसम पर निर्भर है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी बात पर निर्भर; यहाँ ख़राब मौसम का फैलाव तूफ़ान के रास्ते पर निर्भर है।
noteHi.usage: be contingent on/upon sth निश्चित प्रयोग है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 旅行は天気が良いかどうか次第だ。
noteJa.meaning: ～次第の、～に左右される。記事では悪天候の分布が嵐の進路次第であることを表す。
noteJa.usage: be contingent on/upon sth の形で使う。名詞で「派遣団」の意味もある。

noteKo.meaning: ~에 달려 있는, ~에 좌우되는. 기사에서는 악천후의 분포가 폭풍 경로에 달려 있다는 뜻이다.
noteKo.usage: be contingent on/upon sth 형태로 쓴다. 명사로 '대표단'의 뜻도 있다.

counties.en: areas that a country is divided into

country.ex: Ireland is a small country with a big diaspora.

deepening.ex: The low is deepening as it moves north.

deputy.en: second in rank, helping the head
deputy.ex: The deputy manager ran the meeting today.

deviations.en: small changes from an expected path
deviations.ex: Even small deviations from the plan cause delays.

example.en: Any deviation from the plan must be reported.
example.zh: 任何偏離計畫的情況都必須回報。

note.meaning: 偏離、偏差；文中指暴風路徑的些微偏移可能大幅改變惡劣天氣的位置。
note.usage: 名詞，常見 deviation from + 名詞；動詞 deviate from。

noteEn.meaning: a change or move away from what is usual or planned.

noteEs.exampleTr: Cualquier desviación del plan debe comunicarse.
noteEs.meaning: Desviación; aquí, pequeños cambios en la trayectoria de la tormenta.

noteHi.exampleTr: योजना से किसी भी विचलन की सूचना देनी होगी।
noteHi.meaning: सामान्य रास्ते या योजना से हटना; यहाँ तूफ़ान के मार्ग में छोटा बदलाव।
noteHi.usage: deviation from..., minor deviations आम हैं; क्रिया deviate from।

noteJa.exampleTr: 計画からのいかなる逸脱も報告しなければならない。
noteJa.meaning: 逸脱、ずれ。記事では嵐の進路のわずかなずれを指す。
noteJa.usage: deviation from の形でよく使う。動詞は deviate from。

noteKo.exampleTr: 계획에서 벗어나는 일은 모두 보고해야 한다.
noteKo.meaning: 벗어남, 편차. 기사에서는 폭풍 경로의 작은 변화를 뜻한다.
noteKo.usage: deviation from 형태로 자주 쓴다. 동사형은 deviate from.

difference.en: make a difference: change a situation
difference.ex: A good teacher can make a big difference.

director.en: the person in charge of an organisation
director.ex: She became director of the museum last year.

distribution.en: the way something is spread over an area
distribution.ex: The distribution of rain was uneven across the country.

example.en: The map shows the distribution of rainfall across the country.
example.zh: 這張地圖顯示了全國的降雨分布。

note.meaning: 分布、分配；文中指最惡劣天氣在各地的分布情形。
note.usage: 名詞，常接 of；可指地理分布或物資分配，如 the distribution of food。

noteEn.meaning: the way something is spread over an area or shared out.

noteEs.exampleTr: El mapa muestra la distribución de las lluvias en todo el país.
noteEs.meaning: Distribución o reparto; aquí, dónde se dará el peor tiempo.
noteEs.usage: Sustantivo; suele ir con 'of': 'the distribution of', 'uneven distribution'.

noteHi.exampleTr: यह नक्शा देश भर में वर्षा का वितरण दिखाता है।
noteHi.meaning: फैलाव या वितरण; यहाँ ख़राब मौसम कहाँ-कहाँ होगा उसका फैलाव।
noteHi.usage: the distribution of..., uneven distribution आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: その地図は国全体の降水量の分布を示している。
noteJa.meaning: 分布、配分。記事では最悪の天候がどこに現れるかの分布を指す。
noteJa.usage: 名詞で of を伴うことが多い。the distribution of、uneven distribution など。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 지도는 전국의 강수량 분포를 보여 준다.
noteKo.meaning: 분포, 분배. 기사에서는 최악의 날씨가 어디에 나타날지의 분포를 뜻한다.
noteKo.usage: 명사로 of와 자주 쓴다. the distribution of, uneven distribution 등.

down.en: used in 'bear down on': come closer threateningly
down.ex: The storm is bearing down on the coast.

dramatically.ex: The number of visitors rose dramatically.

early.en: near the start of a time period
early.ex: We left early in the morning.

early-morning.ex: I took an early-morning train to the city.

effect.ex: The new rules take effect next month.

emphasised.en: said something strongly to show importance
emphasised.ex: She emphasised the need for safety.

ends.ex: The class ends at four o'clock.

even.en: used to show something is surprising
even.ex: Even a little rain can make roads slippery.

exact.ex: I don't know the exact time of the meeting.

expected.ex: Snow is expected in the hills tonight.

explained.ex: The teacher explained the rules clearly.

falls.en: happens or lands in a place
falls.ex: Most of the rain falls in the west.

feel.ex: Coastal towns will feel the storm first.

fiercest.ex: The fiercest winds hit the coast at night.

first.ex: It was the first snow of the winter.

flood.ex: The river may flood after the heavy rain.

flooding.en: water covering land that is usually dry
flooding.ex: Heavy rain caused flooding in the valley.

follow.en: keep watching or reading news about
follow.ex: I follow the news every morning.

for.en: used to show purpose or who gets something

force.en: power or strength; in force: in effect
force.ex: The force of the wave knocked him over.

forecasts.ex: The forecasts say it will be sunny.

from.en: showing where something starts or comes

fuelled.ex: The fire was fuelled by strong winds.

further.ex: There will be further delays tomorrow.

gales.ex: Gales closed the ferry port all day.

get.ex: The north will get more snow.

given.ex: The school has given a warning about ice.

growing.ex: The wind is growing stronger every hour.

gusts.ex: Gusts of wind shook the windows.

h.ja: H（ミドルネームの頭文字）

has.en: helping verb for the present perfect

hazardous.ex: Ice made the roads hazardous this morning.

example.en: Icy roads make driving hazardous this morning.
example.zh: 結冰的道路使今早開車很危險。

note.meaning: 危險的、有害的；文中指暴雨使交通狀況變得危險。
note.usage: 形容詞，比 dangerous 正式，常見 hazardous conditions/waste/materials。

noteEs.exampleTr: Las carreteras heladas hacen que conducir sea peligroso esta mañana.
noteEs.meaning: Peligroso o arriesgado; aquí, la lluvia hace peligroso viajar.
noteEs.usage: Más formal que 'dangerous'; común en 'hazardous conditions/waste'.

noteHi.exampleTr: बर्फ़ीली सड़कों ने आज सुबह गाड़ी चलाना ख़तरनाक बना दिया है।
noteHi.meaning: ख़तरनाक, जोखिम भरा; यहाँ भारी बारिश से यात्रा ख़तरनाक हो सकती है।
noteHi.usage: dangerous से औपचारिक; hazardous conditions/waste आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 凍った道路のせいで今朝は運転が危険だ。
noteJa.meaning: 危険な、有害な。記事では大雨で移動が危険になることを指す。
noteJa.usage: dangerous より硬い。hazardous conditions/waste などでよく使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 빙판길 때문에 오늘 아침 운전이 위험하다.
noteKo.meaning: 위험한, 유해한. 기사에서는 폭우로 이동이 위험해진다는 뜻이다.
noteKo.usage: dangerous보다 격식 있다. hazardous conditions/waste 등으로 쓴다.

head.ex: She is the head of the science department.

heavy.en: large in amount or very strong

help.en: with the help of: helped by
help.ex: She fixed the car with the help of a friend.
help.zh: with the help of：在…幫助下

hits.ex: The storm hits the coast tonight.

honour.en: in honour of: to show respect for
honour.ex: The park was named in honour of a local hero.

in.en: inside; at a place or time

inaugural.en: the first to hold a position
inaugural.ex: She was the inaugural president of the club.

initial.ex: My initial idea was to take a train.

intensifying.ex: The rain is intensifying this afternoon.

example.en: The rain intensified throughout the afternoon.
example.zh: 整個下午雨勢越來越大。

note.meaning: 增強、加劇；文中指暴風接近西歐時強度不斷增強。
note.usage: 可作及物或不及物動詞，如 the storm intensified / intensify efforts；名詞 intensity。

noteEn.meaning: to become or make something stronger.

noteEs.exampleTr: La lluvia se intensificó durante toda la tarde.
noteEs.meaning: Intensificarse o aumentar; aquí, la tormenta se hace más fuerte.
noteEs.usage: Puede ser transitivo o intransitivo: 'the storm intensifies', 'intensify efforts'.

noteHi.exampleTr: पूरी दोपहर बारिश तेज़ होती गई।
noteHi.meaning: तेज़ होना या बढ़ना; यहाँ पश्चिमी यूरोप के पास आते हुए तूफ़ान तेज़ हो रहा है।
noteHi.usage: सकर्मक व अकर्मक दोनों; intensify efforts, the storm intensifies।

noteJa.exampleTr: 午後の間ずっと雨が強まった。
noteJa.meaning: 強まる、激しくなる。記事では嵐が西ヨーロッパに近づくにつれ勢力を増すことを指す。
noteJa.usage: 自動詞・他動詞の両方で使う。the storm intensifies、intensify efforts など。

noteKo.meaning: 강해지다, 격화되다. 기사에서는 폭풍이 서유럽에 다가오며 세력이 강해진다는 뜻이다.
noteKo.usage: 자동사·타동사 모두 쓴다. the storm intensifies, intensify efforts 등.

into.en: used in 'come into effect': start to apply

issue.ex: Police will issue a statement later today.

issued.ex: The bank issued a warning about fake emails.

jet.en: in 'jet stream': strong fast winds high in the sky
jet.ex: A strong jet stream pushes storms east.
jet.ja: ジェット（ジェット気流）

kick.en: kick in: start to have an effect
kick.ex: The new prices kick in next week.

latest.ex: Have you read her latest book?

likely.ex: It is likely to rain tomorrow.

local.en: in or affecting a nearby small area

localised.en: happening only in a small area
localised.ex: There may be localised showers this afternoon.

low-pressure.en: having low air pressure, bringing bad weather
low-pressure.ex: A low-pressure area often brings clouds and rain.

make.es: hacer (make a difference: marcar la diferencia)
make.ex: A good coat can make a big difference in winter.
make.zh: 造成（make a difference：造成差別）

met.en: short for Meteorological in Met Éireann
met.ja: メット（Met Éireann：アイルランド気象局）

meteorological.en: about the weather and its study
meteorological.ex: The meteorological office tracks every storm.

minor.ex: There was only minor damage to the car.

morning.en: the early part of the day

most.en: used to make the superlative: to the greatest degree
most.ex: This is the most beautiful beach in Spain.

moves.en: goes from one place to another
moves.ex: The cloud moves slowly to the east.

moving.ex: The traffic is moving slowly this morning.

ms.en: a title used before a woman's name

nagle.en: Austen H Nagle, first head of Irish weather service

name.ex: The café changed its name last year.

named.ex: The bridge was named after a local hero.

nevertheless.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.

night.en: the time when it is dark
night.ex: We saw the stars at night.

on.en: used for days; also in phrases like 'bear down on'

pair.en: two things of the same kind
pair.ex: She bought a pair of warm gloves.

pass.ex: The parade will pass the town hall at noon.

path.en: the line along which something moves
path.ex: The hikers followed the path of the river.

persist.ex: If the pain persists, see a doctor.

place.ex: New safety rules are now in place.

placed.ex: The town was placed under a curfew.

places.ex: Some places in the city have no trees.

pm.en: after midday; in the afternoon or evening

powerful.ex: A powerful wind broke the trees.

precise.ex: We need precise measurements before we cut the wood.

example.en: Can you give me the precise time of your arrival?
example.zh: 你能告訴我你確切的抵達時間嗎？

note.meaning: 精確的、確切的；文中指最惡劣天氣的確切分布範圍。
note.usage: 形容詞，常見 precise details/location/time；to be precise 意為「確切地說」。

noteEn.meaning: exact and correct in every detail.

noteEs.exampleTr: ¿Puedes decirme la hora exacta de tu llegada?
noteEs.meaning: Exacto, preciso; aquí, la distribución exacta del mal tiempo.
noteEs.usage: Común en 'precise location/details' y 'to be precise'.

noteHi.exampleTr: क्या आप मुझे अपने पहुँचने का सटीक समय बता सकते हैं?
noteHi.meaning: बिल्कुल सही, सटीक; यहाँ ख़राब मौसम का सटीक फैलाव।
noteHi.usage: precise location/details, to be precise आम प्रयोग हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 到着の正確な時間を教えてもらえますか。
noteJa.meaning: 正確な、精密な。記事では最悪の天候の正確な分布を指す。
noteJa.usage: precise location/details、to be precise（正確に言うと）などで使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 도착하는 정확한 시간을 알려 줄 수 있나요?
noteKo.meaning: 정확한, 정밀한. 기사에서는 최악의 날씨가 나타날 정확한 분포를 뜻한다.
noteKo.usage: precise location/details, to be precise(정확히 말하면) 등으로 쓴다.

progresses.ex: The ship progresses slowly through the ice.

prompting.ex: The heat is prompting people to stay indoors.

rainfall.en: rain; the amount of rain that falls

remain.ex: The roads remain closed after the flood.

reserved.en: kept for one particular place or person
reserved.ex: The front seats are reserved for older people.
reserved.ja: 〜に限られた；取っておかれた

revised.ex: The plan was revised after the meeting.

revision.en: a change to make something more correct

example.en: The timetable is subject to revision without notice.
example.zh: 時刻表可能隨時修改，恕不另行通知。

note.meaning: 修訂、修改；文中 subject to revision 指警報可能隨時調整（IELTS 版用動詞 revise）。
note.usage: 名詞，動詞為 revise；subject to revision 表「可能會修改」；英式也指「複習」。

noteEn.meaning: a change made to improve or update something.

noteEs.exampleTr: El horario está sujeto a cambios sin previo aviso.
noteEs.meaning: Revisión o modificación; aquí, los avisos pueden cambiar.

noteHi.exampleTr: समय-सारणी बिना सूचना के बदली जा सकती है।
noteHi.meaning: संशोधन, बदलाव; यहाँ चेतावनियाँ बदली जा सकती हैं।
noteHi.usage: subject to revision = बदलाव संभव; क्रिया revise।

noteJa.exampleTr: 時刻表は予告なく変更されることがある。
noteJa.meaning: 修正、改訂。記事では警報が変更される可能性があることを指す。
noteJa.usage: subject to revision で「変更の可能性あり」。動詞は revise。英式では「復習」の意も。

noteKo.exampleTr: 시간표는 예고 없이 변경될 수 있다.
noteKo.meaning: 수정, 개정. 기사에서는 경보가 변경될 수 있다는 뜻이다.
noteKo.usage: subject to revision은 '변경될 수 있음'. 동사형은 revise, 영국식으로 '복습'의 뜻도 있다.

revision.zh: 修訂（subject to revision：可能修改）

risk.en: the chance that something bad will happen
risk.ex: Smoking increases the risk of disease.

said.ex: She said the shop was closed.

says.ex: The doctor says I need more sleep.

season.en: a period of the year when something happens
season.ex: The football season starts in August.

second.ex: This is my second visit to Paris.

service.en: an organisation that provides something for the public
service.ex: The ambulance service answered the call quickly.

shifts.en: small changes in position or direction
shifts.ex: A shift in the wind cooled the beach.

significantly.ex: Prices have risen significantly this year.

skirt.en: to pass along the edge of something

small.ex: It's a small town in the west.

some.en: a number or amount of; not all

south.ex: Birds fly to the south in winter.

southern.ex: They live in a southern farming village.

starts.ex: The film starts at eight o'clock.

status.en: the level of a weather warning
status.ex: The county is now under status orange.

storm.en: very bad weather with strong winds and rain

storm's.ex: We watched the storm's clouds roll in.

stream.en: a narrow flow of air or water
stream.ex: The jet stream moved further north this week.
stream.ja: 気流（jet stream：ジェット気流）

strengthened.ex: The wall was strengthened before winter.

stressed.en: said strongly that it is important
stressed.ex: She stressed the need for care.

strong.ex: A strong current pulled the boat away.

stronger.ex: The wind got stronger after dark.

strongest.ex: The strongest gusts hit the coast at dawn.

subject.en: subject to: may be affected by
subject.ex: All prices are subject to change.

example.en: Subsequent tests showed that the water was safe.
example.zh: 後續的檢測顯示水是安全的。

note.meaning: 隨後的、接下來的；文中指第一個警報之後的第二個警報。
note.usage: 形容詞，放名詞前；subsequent to = after（正式）；副詞 subsequently。

noteEs.exampleTr: Las pruebas posteriores mostraron que el agua era segura.
noteEs.meaning: Posterior, siguiente; aquí, el segundo aviso tras el primero.
noteEs.usage: Adjetivo antes del sustantivo; 'subsequent to' = después de (formal).

noteHi.exampleTr: बाद के परीक्षणों से पता चला कि पानी सुरक्षित था।
noteHi.meaning: बाद वाला, अगला; यहाँ पहली चेतावनी के बाद की दूसरी चेतावनी।
noteHi.usage: विशेषण, संज्ञा से पहले; subsequent to = after (औपचारिक)।

noteJa.exampleTr: その後の検査で水は安全だとわかった。
noteJa.meaning: その後の、次の。記事では最初の警報に続く2つ目の警報を指す。
noteJa.usage: 形容詞で名詞の前に置く。subsequent to は after の硬い表現。

noteKo.exampleTr: 이후의 검사에서 물이 안전한 것으로 나타났다.
noteKo.meaning: 그 후의, 다음의. 기사에서는 첫 경보 다음에 오는 두 번째 경보를 뜻한다.
noteKo.usage: 형용사로 명사 앞에 쓴다. subsequent to는 after의 격식 표현이다.

substantial.ex: The new road needs a substantial amount of money.

example.en: The storm caused substantial damage to the houses.
example.zh: 暴風對房屋造成了相當大的損害。

note.meaning: 大量的、相當大的；文中指愛爾蘭南部也可能出現強陣風。
note.usage: 形容詞，常見 substantial amount/increase/damage；副詞 substantially。

noteEn.meaning: large in amount, size or importance.

noteEs.exampleTr: La tormenta causó daños considerables en las casas.
noteEs.meaning: Considerable, importante; aquí, rachas fuertes en el sur.

noteHi.exampleTr: तूफ़ान ने घरों को काफ़ी नुकसान पहुँचाया।
noteHi.meaning: काफ़ी बड़ा या ज़्यादा; यहाँ दक्षिणी क्षेत्रों में तेज़ हवाएँ संभव हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 嵐は家屋にかなりの被害をもたらした。
noteJa.meaning: かなりの、相当な。記事では南部でも強い突風が吹く可能性を表す。
noteJa.usage: 形容詞。substantial amount/increase/damage などで使う。

noteKo.meaning: 상당한, 많은. 기사에서는 남부 지역에도 강한 돌풍이 불 수 있다는 뜻이다.

sweeps.en: moves quickly across a wide area
sweeps.ex: A cold wind sweeps across the hills.

system.en: a large area of weather, e.g. low pressure
system.ex: A high-pressure system will bring dry weather.

take.ex: The new law will take effect next month.

takes.en: takes its name from: is named after
takes.ex: The town takes its name from the river.
takes.zh: takes its name from：以…命名；得名於

that.en: used to introduce what someone says

therefore.ex: It was late; therefore, we took a taxi.

threatening.ex: Rising water is threatening homes near the river.

to.en: towards; until; used before a verb

track.en: to follow a path or course
track.ex: The hurricane is tracking north along the coast.

trajectory.en: the path something follows as it moves
trajectory.ex: The rocket's trajectory was carefully planned.

example.en: Scientists tracked the trajectory of the rocket.
example.zh: 科學家追蹤了火箭的飛行軌跡。

note.meaning: 軌跡、行進路線；文中指暴風移動的路徑。
note.usage: 可數名詞，用於物體路徑，也可比喻發展趨勢，如 career trajectory。

noteEn.meaning: the path that something moves along.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los científicos siguieron la trayectoria del cohete.
noteEs.meaning: Trayectoria o recorrido; aquí, el camino que sigue la tormenta.

noteHi.exampleTr: वैज्ञानिकों ने रॉकेट के मार्ग पर नज़र रखी।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ के चलने का रास्ता; यहाँ तूफ़ान का मार्ग।
noteHi.usage: गणनीय संज्ञा; career trajectory जैसे लाक्षणिक अर्थ में भी।

noteJa.exampleTr: 科学者たちはロケットの軌道を追跡した。
noteJa.meaning: 軌道、進路。記事では嵐の進む道筋を指す。
noteJa.usage: 可算名詞。career trajectory のように比喩的な「推移」にも使う。

noteKo.meaning: 궤적, 진로. 기사에서는 폭풍이 이동하는 경로를 뜻한다.

travel.ex: Snow made travel slow across the north.

treacherous.ex: Ice made the mountain road treacherous.

turbocharged.ex: The new engine turbocharged the car's speed.

under.zh: 在…之下（placed under：被置於…之下）

united.en: part of the name United Kingdom

updated.ex: The map is updated every hour.

updates.ex: The radio gives traffic updates every hour.

valid.en: in effect for a set time
valid.ex: This ticket is valid until Sunday.

vigorous.ex: A vigorous wind blew the leaves away.

warned.ex: Experts warned of a hot summer.

warning.en: a notice that danger may come
warning.ex: The coastguard issued a gale warning.

warnings.ex: The doctor gave several warnings about smoking.

weather.ex: The weather in Spain is usually warm.

western.ex: The western Pacific has many typhoons.

where.ex: Nobody knows where the ball landed.

who.en: used to add information about a person

will.en: used to talk about the future

windy.ex: It was too windy to fly the drone.

winter.en: the coldest season of the year

worst.ex: That was the worst day of my holiday.

yellow.en: the colour of lemons; lowest warning level
yellow.ex: The school bus is bright yellow.

éireann.en: Irish for Ireland (Met Éireann: weather service)

éireann's.ja: メット・エーラン（気象局）の

paragraphs: Storm Austen is coming to Ireland. It is the first storm with a name this autumn and winter.
Met Éireann, the weather service, has given yellow rain warnings. There was a warning for Dublin and Wicklow early on Wednesday morning.
Another warning starts at 7pm on Thursday. It ends at 8am on Friday. There will be heavy rain, and some places may flood. Travel may be difficult.
The storm will pass south of Ireland. The strongest winds will be in Britain. In Ireland, the south may get the strongest winds.
Aoife Kealy from Met Éireann says people should check the latest weather news.
The storm is named after Austen Nagle. In 1936 he became the first head of Ireland's weather service.
Storm Austen, the first named storm of the 2026-2027 season, is moving towards Ireland. Met Éireann has issued yellow rain warnings for Wednesday and Thursday.

A warning for Dublin and Wicklow was in place from 1am to 8am on Wednesday because of heavy rain. A second yellow warning will start at 7pm on Thursday and last until 8am on Friday. Met Éireann says there could be difficult travel conditions and some local flooding.

Aoife Kealy, deputy head of forecasts at Met Éireann, says the storm is growing stronger over the Atlantic with the help of a strong jet stream. It is expected to pass to the south of Ireland. The strongest winds will be in Britain, but the south of Ireland could also be windy.
She says small changes in the storm's path could make a big difference to where the worst weather falls. Warnings may change, so people should follow the latest updates.
The storm is named after Austen H Nagle, who became the first director of the Irish Meteorological Service in 1936.
Storm Austen, the first named storm of the 2026-2027 season, is heading towards Ireland, prompting Met Éireann to issue status yellow rain warnings for Wednesday and Thursday.

A warning for Dublin and Wicklow was valid from 1am to 8am on Wednesday, with heavy rain expected to cause difficult travel and localised flooding. A further yellow warning will come into effect at 7pm on Thursday and remain in place until 8am on Friday as the storm moves eastward across the country.

Aoife Kealy, Met Éireann's deputy head of forecasts, said the storm was being fuelled by a strong jet stream and was deepening as it approached western Europe. It is expected to track to the south of Ireland, bringing heavy rain and possibly strong winds, with the most powerful gusts likely in the UK.
She warned that even small shifts in the path of the low-pressure system could significantly change where the worst weather hits on Thursday night and Friday, and that warnings could be updated.
The storm takes its name from Austen H Nagle, who was appointed the first director of the Irish Meteorological Service in 1936.
